components.name: card
components.why: GDS deliberately has no generic card; summary-list cards cover the check-answers case only. Kept intentionally narrow: heading, optional description, optional meta, an optional brand-green header band, and EITHER a whole-card link OR footer actions. No images, no nested cards. If a request needs a new option, that is a signal the layout wants a different component. Follows GOV.UK publishing components, and card components in several departmental systems.

params.name: title
params.description: The card heading.

params.name: headingLevel
params.description: Heading level, 2 to 6. Defaults to 2. Set it so the card does not skip a level in the page's heading order.

params.name: headerColour
params.description: Renders the heading in a coloured band. `green` (the Defra brand green) is the only supported value — it is the role the branding guidance sanctions for that colour. The banded title is white and its size and weight are pinned, because white on this green (3.33:1) conforms only under the large-text threshold.

params.name: href

params.name: meta

params.name: text
params.description: Description. Ignored if `html` is set.

params.name: actions
params.description: Footer links. Setting this disables whole-card clicking, because an overlay would make these unreachable.

params.name: text
params.description: Link text.

params.name: href
params.description: Link destination.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Appended for screen readers, so repeated actions are distinguishable out of context.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the card.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes to add to the card.
